title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
abstract: arXiv:2611.24395v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Improving the efficiency of training and inference infrastructure is a practical component of recursive self-improvement. Existing benchmarks for agent-driven optimization largely focus on individual software layers such as kernel, leaving unclear whether agents can deliver end-to-end performance gains under production workloads. We introduce RSIBench-Infra, a benchmark of 20 training and inference tasks spanning diverse model families and modalities, with deployments of up to 32 accelerators on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend NPUs. Agents start from runnable baselines derived from official recipes and can modify the software stack across engine, kernel, and instruction levels. An OCI image-layer submission protocol captures these changes for reproducible deployment, while independent evaluation measures end-to-end performance under task-specific quality constraints. translated_title: RSIBench-Infra：智能体能否在生产规模下优化自身的训练与推理基础设施？
translated_abstract: 提升训练与推理基础设施的效率是递归自我改进的一个实际组成部分。现有的智能体驱动优化基准大多聚焦于单一软件层（如内核），尚不清楚智能体能否在生产工作负载下带来端到端的性能提升。我们提出了 RSIBench-Infra，这是一个包含 20 个训练与推理任务的基准，涵盖多种模型家族和模态，部署规模最高可达 32 个加速器，覆盖 NVIDIA GPU 与昇腾 NPU。智能体从基于官方方案构建的可运行基线出发，可以在引擎、内核和指令层级对软件栈进行修改。OCI 镜像层提交协议记录这些更改以实现可复现部署，同时由独立评估在任务特定的质量约束下衡量端到端性能。在所有任务结果中，66.2% 实现了超过 1.10 倍且经过验证的有效加速。这些结果……
tldr: 该论文提出了 RSIBench-Infra，一个面向生产规模、评估智能体能否在引擎、内核和指令层级对训练与推理基础设施进行端到端优化的基准，结果显示 66.2% 的任务实现了超过 1.10 倍的有效加速。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RSIBench-Infra, a production-scale benchmark of 20 training and inference tasks evaluating whether agents can deliver end-to-end infrastructure optimizations across engine, kernel, and instruction levels, with 66.2% of task results achieving validated speedups exceeding 1.10×.
